heuristics.statement: Our theory: the first blocks M0 are fresh uniform 512-bit strings; their chaining values CV1 = F_37(IV, M0) behave as independent uniform 256-bit values; in particular x = A_{-1} is uniform on 2^32 and independent of cb = C6 - A_{-2}, which is uniform on 2^32. Consequences used: each of the 170 classes passes the W7 test with probability p7 = |F7|/2^32 exactly, each variant of a passing class then passes F6 with probability p6 = |F6|/2^32 exactly, and given both, W0..W5 are uniform and independent of (W6, W7) (proof.md Lemma 5.1); hence the expected number of good pairs per first block is g = 599,760 p7 p6 = 636.680, the expected counts of the ledger, and the independence of distinct first blocks.
heuristics.scope: The expected numbers of passing classes, good pairs, survivors and row-16 passes per first block; the expected operation count of the counted program; the law of the second-block words that defines q3; independence across first blocks (proof.md Section 10). Not the validity of any output: every output is verified with the target.
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured by 7319bba with the attack's own filters on real first blocks in C (2^21 and 2^23 first blocks: passing classes 7,400,134 and 29,545,568 against 7,388,160 and 29,552,640 expected; good pairs ratio 1.0034 and 1.0011; row-16 pairs z = +0.88, +0.51), by this filing's simulation of the counted program on 20,000 real first blocks (passing classes per first block 3.457 against the exact 3.523, good pairs 836.3 against 831.0, mean counted operations 28377 against the ledger's 28289), by the unconditional sample in a0-online-r37 (64 organizer-seeded first blocks per active trial: 90,682 class W7 passes in 25,600 first blocks of our 400-trial run against 90,187 expected), and by the organizer experiment h1-cv1-filters-nonce, which counts on 150 organizer-seeded real first blocks per trial how often the W7 filter (first class) and the W6 filter (its first four variants) pass (expected 2.38 and 40.1 per trial; our replays, 100 trials each: 244 and 214 W7 passes against 238.0, 4,011 and 3,988 W6 passes against 4,013.7; Appendix H). These are at most 2^23 real first blocks, not 2^55.8. heuristics.limitations: Premise (our theory), not a theorem: the filter rates are measured on at most 2^23 real first blocks and on the organizer's small samples, not at the 2^55.8 first blocks of the attack, and independence across first blocks is assumed, not tested. The class tests of one first block are strongly correlated (their c7 values are close), so per-first-block counts are overdispersed; only their expectations and the independence across first blocks are used. The class test uses the single word x, so H1 is also an assumption about that word of the digest of a 37-step compression.

heuristics.statement: For a good pair, q3 = the average over the 599,760 variants of the 170 classes (each equally likely, as examined here) and the 32 elements of L* of Pr[rows 16..21 of both members follow every cell and every printed two-bit condition closing at rows 16..21 (corrected reading A15[29] = A17[29]), the eight value bits E18[1,5,10,11,18,28,29] and E19[29] of Table 15 not imposed, and (R16x) E16[23] = 0 and E16[24] = E17[24] not imposed: exactly the cells and conditions of experiments/lowm.py, and the two 37-step outputs are equal (rows 22..36 are computed without cell tests, Section 7.7)] satisfies q3_used = 2^-71.4162 x 2.482 = 2^-70.10470 <= q3 <= 2^-71.38 x 2.4902 = 2^-70.0637, where q3 = q3c x R: q3c, the probability that rows 16..36 follow every cell, satisfies 2^-71.4162 <= q3c <= 2^-71.38, where q3c_used = 2^-71.4162 is the one-sided 99 percent Student lower bound of the mean of the 16,384 LINEAR estimates of block F on this filing's own variant list (Appendix N: seeds 800000..816383, mean(est) 2^-71.41331, relative sd of the linear estimates 0.1095, t = 2.3266 at 16383 df, bound 2^-71.41618), rounded down to four decimals of log2 and never up, with no sub-pool transfer allowance; the parents'-pool pooled 256-replicate statistic (mean 2^-71.4236, relative sd 0.1118, t = 2.3413 at 254 df, bound 2^-71.4474, claim 57.61579, or 2^-71.4494 with the 0.0020-bit allowance, claim 57.61777) remains a stated sensitivity, over the same two blocks whose per-block bounds are 2^-71.4629 and 2^-71.4524 (one-sided 99 percent upper bounds 2^-71.3970 and 2^-71.3838); the preregistered min-of-blocks rule (2^-71.4629, claim 57.63119 on this ledger) and the two-decimal rule (2^-71.47, claim 57.63824) remain stated as conservative sensitivities of the means of two preregistered blocks of 128 replicates (NP = 8192) of a sequential Monte-Carlo estimator written for this filing (Appendices F and G), run on exactly this family with both relaxations as one carrier; and R = Pr[equal outputs | rows 16..21] / Pr[cells of rows 22..36 | rows 16..21] satisfies EXQ = 2.482 <= R <= 1275/512 = 2.4902, where 2.482 is the preregistered one-sided 99 percent lower bound, below every overdispersion-robust bound computed, of the ratio of collision events to cell events after row 21 measured by our 4ec21bf9-f588-4b80-bb2b-77c1ccf8c9b7 (R37R, passed review; its Appendix D.3: 2.4648 +- 0.0145 on Table 15 states, 2.4552 on ffbe30bb's states, 2.46455 under the attack's kept-fibre law of (W7, W8)) and 1275/512 is the uniform-model value of its Appendix D.2; this heuristic explicitly includes the statistical and procedural premise that the participant-reported preregistrations, complete contiguous seed lists (710000..710063, 720000..720127, 721000..721127, 740000..740127, 741000..741127), fixed two-block min(LB) rule, interim progress monitoring during execution, and prior condition-relaxation screening (adopting the four row-18/19 patterns and R16x after screening 30 candidate condition pairs) do not introduce selection, optional-stopping, or multiple-comparison bias exceeding the margin between the two disjoint-seed block estimates, the 6-seed direct full-path check and the declared floors q3c_used = 2^-71.4162 (block F's own one-sided 99 percent bound, Appendix N) and EXQ = 2.482.
heuristics.scope: The expected number of successes E[X] = N_FB g 32 q3 and hence N_FB (proof.md Sections 7 and 10), including the validity of the offline SMC estimation protocol, seed selection, stopping rule, and relaxation screening that support q3c_used = 2^-71.4162, and the ratio EXQ = 2.482. heuristics.extrapolation: Lemma 7.1: rows 16..22 have exactly the same probability for every variant; a variant enters rows >= 23 only through W8 in W23 and W24, so only the four W24 conditions can depend on it (about 2^-4 for every W8x). Our estimator (exact row 16, exact importance weights at rows 17..21, (W6, W7) uniform on F6 x F7, W8 drawn uniformly from the 599,760 variants; Appendix F) was preregistered (validation V with Table 15 cells: mean 2^-73.9911, bound 2^-74.0064, z = +0.66 against the registered study B of 7319bba, mean 2^-73.9987, bound 2^-74.0225, validation PASSES both preregistered criteria (|z| <= 2.576; bound within 0.04 of -74.0225); main blocks R1 and R2 with the eight value characters of the two E cells removed: means 2^-71.9975 and 2^-71.9868, relative sd 0.0714 and 0.0681, bounds 2^-72.0191 and 2^-72.0074, declared 2^-72.02; stage factors of rows 18, 19 and 21 -8.00, -10.00 and -2.00 bits against -15.00, -6.00 and -1.00 for Table 15, structural gain 2.00) and again with R16x (constants written from the counted program; the same binary reproduces the four-pattern outputs byte for byte; joint blocks J1 and J2: means 2^-71.4296 and 2^-71.4177, relative sd 0.1096 and 0.1143, lower bounds 2^-71.4629 and 2^-71.4524, upper bounds 2^-71.3970 and 2^-71.3838, 0.55 bits above the four patterns alone; our earlier full-path test of R16x with independent rehash of all 30,814 collisions gave +0.590 bit [0.548, 0.631]). In addition, the organizer experiment a0-sfs-r37 constructs and verifies full 37-step SFS collisions across 128 classes and all 8 pattern branches (63/64 on patterns 0..3 and 57/64 on R16x patterns 4..7 on our seeds ours-A-0..127; 13 of 13 returned pairs of trials 0..15 are found by the counted program), and the organizer experiment h3-ladder-r37 runs the row-16 stage of q3 on organizer seeds: 41 exact row-16 passes among 98,216 W6 passes (4.2e-4, two seed sets) against the 4.9e-4 (2^-11) per probed lane of the ledger (Appendix H). The four-pattern relaxation (exactly four feasible patterns, three verified further collisions) is ffbe30bb's; here the three collisions are re-checked against this package's cells. R16x is ours (each of its two conditions alone is necessary; a sweep of 30 further condition pairs found no further gain). Here the examined law is the studied law (every variant of every passing class, no weighting), so no hedge is added. The collision event after row 21 (Section 7.7): given rows 16..21, the outputs are equal iff E22[29] = 1, s1(W22') - s1(W22) = 0x4fff9f30 and dW26 = 0, with the uniform-model ratio 1275/512 = 2.4902 (4ec21bf9, Appendix D.2); the measured ratio is 2.4648 +- 0.0145 (Table 15 states), 2.4552 (ffbe30bb's states, three runs, the last preregistered) and 2.46455 (the attack's kept-fibre law, preregistered), every cell event also a collision event in every run, and the preregistered rule gives EXQ = min(2.482, 2.4443) = 2.482 (4ec21bf9, Appendices D.3, D.3b). With q3c one bit lower (q3 = 2^-72.4629 x 2.482) the claim would be 58.71038 (60.49449 under A_C = 2^60), with the four patterns alone (q3c = 2^-72.02) 58.29762 (60.38630 under A_C = 2^60), with the Table 15 value 2^-74.03 60.30330 (61.15945 under A_C = 2^60), and with the cell event of rows 22..36 instead of the collision event (EXQ = 1) 58.99371 (60.58264 under A_C = 2^60). These sensitivities use P4 prices and unchanged predicates with alternative q3 floors, rational 40-bit mantissas and ceil N_FB; the primary slack is retained or increased on the 10^-20 grid to preserve its Bernstein exponent, with time rounded upward to five decimals. Using the preregistered two-decimal floor 2^-71.47 gives 57.63824 (60.30327 under A_C = 2^60); the J2 bound alone 2^-71.4524 gives 57.88819 (60.29997 under A_C = 2^60), without replacing the declared min-block floor. P4 public-seed participant observations: a0-sfs returned/checked 121 pairs, detected 16/16; ladder row16=37/81608 W6 passes. Two byte-identical executor runs; no holdout. See the P4 executor observations section for runtimes and N/S/P/C/R.
heuristics.limitations: A Monte-Carlo and procedural premise, not a theorem: (1) its coverage rests on the approximate normality of the mean of 128 replicates (relative sd 0.1096 and 0.1143, about twice the Table 15 study's because few children survive the row-19 stage); row-22 survivors are heavily duplicated within a replicate; the row-22 stage draws (W6, W7) uniformly from F6 x F7, which is argued, not measured; depends on the reading of the '+' cells; (2) the offline preregistration timestamps/hashes (PREREG_q3M.txt, PREREG_q3R16x.txt) and contiguous seed lists (710000..710063, 720000..720127, 721000..721127, 740000..740127, 741000..741127) are participant-reported without an organizer holdout nonce, interim progress looks were taken while blocks ran (Appendices F.2 and G.2), and screening R16x against 30 other condition pairs before running J1 and J2 is not a multiplicity-adjusted holdout test, so the absence of material selection, optional-stopping, or multiple-testing bias is an explicit part of heuristic H2 rather than an externally certified guarantee; (3) no organizer experiment executes the end event of q3: rows 22..36 reach the digest only through a second-block chaining value that must be equal, which needs a reachable first block, that is the attack itself (a0-sfs-r37 returns semi-free-start pairs and no full collision of the target); the organizer-executed h3-ladder-r37 runs only the row-16 stage of q3 on organizer seeds; (4) EXQ is a Monte-Carlo bound from the runs of 4ec21bf9, not a theorem: those runs draw (W6, W7) uniformly from F6 x F7 and W8 from the variant list of that filing, on Table 15's and ffbe30bb's row-21 states and, in the preregistered fourth run, a pool of kept fibres of that filing's table; the ratio depends on W8 only through W24 = s1(W22) + W17 + s0(W9) + W8 and was not re-measured on this family's 599,760 variants or on the row-21 states that R16x adds; the runs share resampled row-21 states, so their counts are overdispersed (run 3: chi-square 55.4 on 31 df), which the quasi-binomial and cluster bounds allow for; no organizer experiment estimates the ratio. Premise (our theory): q3 is our computation, with the estimator, the preregistrations and the per-seed estimates printed in Appendices F and G. The count of four patterns is a solver enumeration (Bitwuzla; Z3 on smaller cases) for the published dense part with the signed cells of rows 14 and 15 kept (with rows 12..15 removed as well it admits 128 patterns); other dense parts were not explored, and our estimator does not use the solver. R16x has no solver enumeration: its value rests on the estimator, on a0-sfs-r37, and on our full-path test with rehashed collisions; patterns of rows 16..21 outside the program's cells (for example the E18 XOR pattern {24,23,16,15}) are not counted. A stated premise, not an established fact.

heuristics.statement: Averaged over the trials t = (first block, variant, l) of a first block f weighted by their success probabilities, the expected number of other successful trials of the same first block given that t succeeds is at most 2^-9.4: sum_t Pr[A_t] E[X_f - 1 | A_t] <= 2^-9.4 E[X_f]. Equivalently: (a) the expected number of other l in L* succeeding with the same variant is at most 2^-11, and (b) for other good pairs t' of the same first block, Pr[t' succeeds | t succeeds, t' good] <= 2^35 Pr[t' succeeds | t' good].
heuristics.scope: The per-first-block Bonferroni bound Pr[X_f >= 1] >= (1 - 2^-10.4) E[X_f] (proof.md Section 10). The good pairs of a first block and their dependence structure are those of 7319bba; this filing changes the order in which they are processed, not the set.
heuristics.extrapolation: (a) 7319bba's replay of 19,620,436 distinct Step-3 successes of the SMC: rebuilding W0..W5 and testing the other 31 elements of L* through rows 14..36 gave 0 further successes (rule-of-three 95 percent bound 2^-22.65 per success; the accepted patterns raise the chance of passing rows 18 and 19 by about 4 and R16x the chance of the whole path by about 1.6, with four more l holding row 16, so about 2^-19.8, far below 2^-11; in that replay the other l fail at row 16 or 17; the collision event changes only rows 22..36, so (a), decided at rows 16 and 17, is unchanged). (b) Summing over all other trials t' = (f, a0', l') in the family uses the family average of Pr[t' succeeds | t' good], which is q3 <= 2^-71.38 x 2.4902 = 2^-70.0637 (H2, Section 7.7; no per-trial uniformity across (a0, l) is required), so the expected number of further successes among other good pairs is at most rho x N_good x 32 x q3 with N_good <= 599,760 (all variants of the family): 2^35 x 2^19.58 x 2^5 x 2^-70.0637 = 2^-10.4837, so delta <= 2^-11 + 2^-10.4837 = 2^-9.7189 < 2^-9.4; the measured factor at the row-16 level over 2^21 and 2^23 real first blocks is 0.98 and 1.00. The organizer experiment h3-cowpass-nonce counts the first blocks in which several variants of one class pass F6 together, and h3-ladder-r37 (Appendix H) counts, on organizer-seeded real first blocks, the pairs of distinct variants of one first block that both pass each level of the attack through the exact row-16 test, against the pairs expected if they passed independently: our replays (two seed sets) give the dependence factor 3.62 and 4.92 at the W6 filter (variants of one class share bits), 0.99 and 1.00 at historical aa0e8b6 LO12 and 0.95 and 0.94 at historical MID12 (P4 public-seed ladder R: W6=3.250842, FIRST13 (lo)=0.995964, SECOND11 (mid)=0.949225, exact row 16=1.048555; N/S/P/C and exact rational calculation are in the P4 executor observations section.), and 1.27 and 0.67 at the exact row-16 test (32 and 9 passes). This is the bound of the earlier filings on this family; the whole family G would give 2^-6.5 and is not used. heuristics.limitations: Premise (our theory): rows 17..36 are not reachable by any organizer experiment of 20 s; for them rho = 2^35 over the measured factor (0.67 to 1.27 through row 16 on organizer seeds; 0.98 and 1.00 over 2^21 and 2^23 real first blocks) is the stated allowance. Rows >= 17 of distinct good pairs cannot be measured jointly within one first block; the premise leaves a margin of 2^35 over the measured row-16 factor, and the margin over the number of examined pairs is thin (delta <= 2^-9.72 against 2^-9.4). The replay samples are correlated through SMC resampling. A stated premise, not an established fact.

heuristics.scope: The preprocessing part of the ledger (2^50.32305) and the advice (below 2^13 bytes).
heuristics.extrapolation: proof.md Section 11.2. A_S: 2^8.7 times the paper's reported Step-1 cost; the completion of a Step-1 solution to a full 37-step semi-free-start pair is reproduced in this package in about 25 milliseconds per pair (organizer experiment a0-sfs-r37). A_C: at the CPU-second price calibrated in the accepted filing 6eeefb64 (2^21.427 units at C = 2644 per solver CPU-second), A_C = 2^48 units is 2^26.57 solver CPU-seconds (~3.17 core-years), > 169 times (2^7.39x) the 593,858 solver CPU-seconds (2^40.61 units) that filing charged as a measured complete re-run of the predecessor 35-step search; we also report sensitivity across the full unamortized allowance spectrum: A_C = 2^56 gives time_log2 = 58.07620, A_C = 2^60 gives 60.26431, and A_C = 2^64 gives 64.01802. P4 organizer executor observations under public seed hashsmash-public-seed-v1, no holdout nonce: 256 requested trials per experiment, two fresh executions with byte-identical stdout only. Internal counters are participant observations; the organizer independently checks returned-pair target events. These runs do not prove full-scale probabilities, H1-H7 or q3. P4 participant observations: 118 returned pairs and checks_passed=118; detected_by_counted_program=16 for all 16 returned trials 0..15. Organizer checked all 256 trial records (121 returned pairs), with 0 full-target collisions; SFS validity remains an internal participant check. Runtime 7.65/7.48 s versus 20 s.
heuristics.limitations: The 37-step characteristic search time is unpublished; A_C = 2^48 is calibrated with a 2^7.39x factor above the accepted measurement of the predecessor 35-step search (593,858 solver CPU-seconds = 2^40.61 units in 6eeefb64), not a direct measurement of the paper's search. A_C = 2^56 would give time_log2 = 58.07620, A_C = 2^60 would give 60.26431, and A_C = 2^64 would give 64.01802.

heuristics.statement: Under collision-frontier-v5 a word-RAM program of 256-bit primitives in which every executed load, store, logic operation, shift, addition, comparison, branch and jump is one primitive is charged by the primitives it executes. The W7 class test (106 primitives for all 170 classes) and the W6 test of a batch of 256 reps (181 to 301 primitives, and 11 to 28 for each subtraction run) are straight-line plane programs whose counts do not depend on the data, produced by a plane algebra in which static constants fold and complemented planes carry an inversion flag at no cost, and in which a NOT is paid when an AND or OR meets unequal flags; two batches are processed together bit by bit with at most 20 live planes each (64 registers, no spill). The group of four members is 32 primitives (29 packed-u, two packed address words that give all four lanes' first- and middle-stage addresses, and the work counter), the first probe stage 12 primitives per four lanes plus six per nonzero FIRST word (1513/8192), the residual exact row-16 test 13, and the zero-base scan_table at word address 0 prices CLS_LANE = 5, SCAN_LANE = 6 and SURV_LANE = 6, with the scalar and control items of proof.md Section 9. All tables, the code (86,416 inherited bytes plus a 1,024-byte allowance) and the constants occupy 1,031,920 bytes = 2^19.976884, below 2^20 bytes. The 170 classes are base | s for s in the four kept lists 0, 1, 5 and 6 (computed, checked for all 599,760 variants); a list is the union of 2^|B| translates of its reps by the cube B of free bits {0, 2, 3} or {0}, and F6(W6x) does not depend on a cube bit s_b when q_b = 1 or on s_0 when CB3_0 = 1 (Lemma 8.2: proved from the constants of S and checked), which the program uses to run only the main combination and subtract the constants of the other 2^|Q0| - 1 combinations that matter.
heuristics.scope: The class-test, W6, scan, gather, group, probe and survivor terms of the ledger (essentially all of the 15783.56 data-dependent operations per first block), the fixed terms, the memory figure and the preprocessing bound (2^38 operations).
heuristics.extrapolation: The program is experiments/lowm.py (the plane programs assert their counts at every execution; process_cv counts every scalar item where it executes; the realized operation count of every category equals its closed formula on 20,000 simulated first blocks). It is exact against the scalar definitions: every lane of every class-test plane and every pass plane equals the F7 or F6 test of its definition (34,000 and 33,570 lanes in selftest, and every lane of every processed class in a0-online-r37), the sets of good pairs (all members, after the expansion of the reps) equal the brute-force sets, the address u equals W0 + s0(W1) from the step equations, the exact row-16 test equals the enumeration of 2,097,152 pairs on all 32 l (Appendix A) and the generic row check on random and near-miss values, and the table stage never rejects a member. These reported simulations are inherited aa0e8b6 evidence; P4 organizer execution completed; The changed table and residual predicates are independently exhaustively checked. P4 organizer executor observations under public seed hashsmash-public-seed-v1, no holdout nonce: 256 requested trials per experiment, two fresh executions with byte-identical stdout only. Internal counters are participant observations; the organizer independently checks returned-pair target events. These runs do not prove full-scale probabilities, H1-H7 or q3. P4 participant observations: 512 unconditional first blocks, 2070 class passes; 52 selected first blocks, 24 processed classes, 7152 good pairs, 25 survivors. class_lane_mismatches, pass_lane_mismatches, goodset_mismatches, address_mismatches, row16_mismatches and cell_mismatches each total 0. Five returned pairs, 0 organizer full-target collisions. Runtime 1.92/1.93 s versus 20 s.
heuristics.limitations: No organizer ruling is cited for the plane algebra (static constants and inversion flags are compile-time facts of the text; the W6 programs have 32 to 84 inversion flips that cost nothing because XORs absorb them and AND/OR of equally flagged planes use De Morgan; pricing every one of them as a NOT would give 58.0603, or 60.3339 under A_C = 2^60) or for the register argument, which is a count of live planes, not a register allocation. The code size is a bound (at most 8192 primitives of at most 8 bytes). Branch pricing follows the earlier filings (a branch on a register is one primitive). The ceiling of the group count and the survivor scan are charged at their worst case (below 0.2 percent of the data-dependent work).

heuristics.statement: The 0.39 floor is reached with named constants: the requirement mu_req = -ln(0.61 - Pcap - 2^-60)/(1 - 2^-10.4) = 0.494663290 at the assumed cap Pcap = 5.3e-07 (= 53/100,000,000, the computed Bernstein bound of this family 2^-20.86760 = 5.226702643e-07 rounded up to the ledger's 1e-8 grid), rounded up to 0.49466329; N_FB is the ceiling of mu_req/(g 32 q3_cell x EXQ), so the achieved mean E[X] = N_FB g 32 q3 = 0.49466329 >= mu_req, and the floor 1 - exp(-(1 - 2^-10.4) mu_req) - Pcap - 2^-60 = 0.3900000006222779 > 0.39. No other mu0 value is used anywhere in the package.
heuristics.extrapolation: Every allowance is an explicit term of the floor equation: the Bernstein cap-failure bound Pcap (Section 10, from vmax_fb = 549125805207/10 and vbar = 2146032149427083/137438953472; computed 2^-20.86760 = 5.226702643e-07 against the assumed 3.9e-07), the repeated-first-block allowance 2^-60, and the H3 discount as the divisor (1 - 2^-10.4). Appendix C recomputes mu_req, the achieved mean and the floor with 60-digit decimals and asserts the floor > 0.39; lowm.py ledger() iterates Pcap and N_FB to a fixed point, prints mu_req and pcap_log2, and asserts the same floor.
heuristics.limitations: The 0.39 floor is the organizer's success requirement; the equation makes the arithmetic exact rather than adding slack, so the margin above 0.39 is 3.9e-9 and the reported floor must be read at the precision it is printed to. The cap bound needs H1 (the independence of the first blocks) and the bound vmax_fb on one first block's work; a Chebyshev bound would force the slack 2^-11 and Pcap = 0.00023325 (Section 10). No eight-decimal constant other than the requirement 0.49466329 is used anywhere in the package.

heuristics.statement: Every phase this submission runs executes with peak resident memory no greater than the declared 1,031,920 bytes = 2^19.976884, below 2^20: the 2^29-candidate family discovery is streamed against a 65,536-byte key table and 2,080 bytes of counters, the list/plane/table build uses at most 2^17 bytes of scratch from the not-yet-initialised scan-table region and never duplicates a final table, and the advice (the published characteristic, its conditions, the Step-1 solution and the SFS pair) is stored data of at most 2^13 bytes (proof.md Section 14.3). No search is omitted: the program runs no solver.
heuristics.scope: Peak resident memory of the submitted program at every phase, together with the retained advice. The work of those phases is charged separately in time under A_S = 2^50 and A_C = 2^48; memory has no scalar contribution under collision-frontier-v5 and is reported and reviewed as a metric.
heuristics.extrapolation: The key table is bounded by the 520 distinct c7 values and at most eight masks each; a pass that exceeds 4,096 entries is repeated over the same stream under a different key partition, and four passes (4 x 2^36 = 2^38 = PRE) are charged, so the streaming argument costs nothing outside the preprocessing budget already charged. FIRST, SECOND, the scan table and its successor table (8192 words each) are disjoint regions of the same 1,031,920 bytes and are written in place (proof.md 14.1-14.3). The advice is the cited work's published Tables 15-17, stored rather than recomputed, and its construction is charged in time at A_S = 2^50 and A_C = 2^48, 2^50.32 units together, more than 169 times the measured complete re-run of the predecessor search.
heuristics.limitations: The published characteristic's own search time was never reported by the cited work; A_C = 2^48 is a calibrated allowance more than 169 times the accepted measurement of the predecessor 35-step search (sensitivities at A_C = 2^56, 2^60 and 2^64 are stated in proof.md 11.2), so the time bound for that step is an allowance rather than a measurement. Memory has no scalar contribution under collision-frontier-v5; it is a reported metric and this statement is what supports it.
